text.text_excerpt: Great spot! We were told by someone living in New Orleans about this hotel bar/restaurant and we were very impressed with our experience. We were immediately greeted by a very professional and polite bartender named Patrick, you can tell he genuinely enjoys his job as a mixologist. It was a great breath of fresh air getting off of Bourbon Street to find something a tad more "classy". He makes one hell of a Margarita!! Loved it. Very refreshing, not full of sour mix. We ordered some bar food to snack on, please keep in mind the portions of the Fry plates are enough to feed 2-4 people depending on how hungry you are. I wish we would have listened to his advice. the ambience is nice. its in the hyatt french quarter. the drinks are delicious. most of the drinks are made from infused cocktails. we tried the pecan manhattan and basil gin. both were delicious. we also had some food. the nachos were amazing. we also had the cuban cajun, which was good but not great. the service was very good as well. our bartender makes some of the infusions so he was very knowledgeable. it is also very quiet, unlike mosy of bourbon st. so it is a nice start to the night

This bar is located in the Hyatt Centric hotel in the French Quarter. I saw barrels in the bar area and immediately thought BOURBON!!! I chatted up the bartender who told me that he infuses bourbons and that I could try a flight of 3 for $10. You know I did! Here were the flavors: Bacon - very smooth with just a hint of bacon Fig - smooth with a hint of sweet Peach - smooth with a nice peach flavor This was a great value. They also have a option for $55 where they will fill a flask with your favorite infused liquor to take home. I saw a pineapple jalapeño infused tequila that I'll likely try tomorrow.
